verdict.rationale: The README shows models loaded from the command line (`llama cli -hf ...`, `llama serve -hf ...`) and CPU+GPU hybrid inference for partial offload. Community reports corroborate configurable GPU layer offload (N_GPU_LAYERS, via Python wrappers) and GPU/CPU model splitting. Missing for 10: any evidence of a context-length flag, and documentation of the specific CLI offload flags (e.g. a GPU-layers option) in the first-party evidence.
